Scale 1.5:1 plans, 2:1 section, 8:1 detail, on A3. Dimensions in mm, computed from the model.
Datum A: back-left corner of the box round the outline, seen from above. X to the right, Y toward the front.
3-axis, two setups: inside up, then underside up.
Every vertical pocket corner is R1.5 or larger: a 3 mm end mill reaches them all. The USB opening's rounds are not vertical: see its detail.
45 degree chamfers: 1.7 on the underside rim, the flank and ends of the lap ridges, 0.3 on the USB lead-in.
The outer skin's top edge at the gap stays sharp, and so does the rim inside the gap: the top seats on it.
The rim steps in 1 mm over the top 1.6 mm, all round: that is the gap. Cut it with the side of the end mill in setup 1.
Screw holes go straight through: M2 x 8 socket head from below.
Outline corners: one quintic Bezier each, control points 10.94, 6.56 and 2.19 mm from the box corner on both sides. Take the curve from the STEP file.
Laser mark on the underside: see LASER MARK and engraving_underside.dxf. The STEP file is the master for all geometry not dimensioned on this sheet.
Bead blast all over, 120 to 150 grit glass bead, then anodise
to MIL-A-8625 Type II, Class 1 (clear, not dyed), 8 to 12 um.
Colour: natural silver, as in the renders. Cosmetic faces: the
About half the coating builds up: each face grows 0.004 to
0.006 mm. The tolerances below hold after anodise.
Break unmarked edges 0.05. The 0.3 chamfers are cosmetic:
Rack marks: on the inner cavity walls, below the rim only.
GROUND: mask the counterbore seat of S1 from anodise.
S1-S6 positions from datum A: ±0.05, on both parts.
Setup 1: cut the light channels last, after the cavity is
roughed: 3 mm 3-flute end mill, 0.2 mm radial steps, full
depth in two passes. Each channel leaves a free 1.0 mm skin.
Setup 2 (underside up): sit the base on a plug fixture that
fills the cavity, 0.1 mm smaller all round and 4 mm tall, so
it backs up both skins. Hold it with an M2 screw through each
of the six holes into the fixture, or in soft jaws cut to the
outline below the gap. Never in a plain vise.
Face: the underside, the flat floor face between the foot
Process: fibre laser, after anodise. Fill every closed contour
on layer MARK of engraving_underside.dxf (hatch about 0.03 mm,
a guess); do not mark layer REF. Colour: the light grey,
frosted mark a fibre laser leaves on clear anodise. Mark one
Position: the DXF is drawn as seen from below, not mirrored,
with its origin at datum A. Seen from below with the USB edge
away from you, datum A is the top-right corner of the outline
box, so a point at (X, Y) in the table above is at (-X, -Y) in
the DXF. Register on the REF outline and holes.
